title: Health, liquidation incentives, bad debt and epoch boundaries
confirm: Can a position be made unliquidatable (dust, blocked token, revert in a hook)?
Does the liquidation incentive exceed what the collateral can pay at the boundary; who absorbs bad debt?
Epoch or accrual boundary: can an action be timed just before or after accrual to skip or double it?
Credit delegation / intermediate vaults: is the delegated limit re-checked after price moves?
